"Starvation Mode" is what fat people think will happen to you if you don't eat "enough". Essentially, you will gain weight by not eating because your body thinks it's starving. (They are, however, unable to accurately explain why victims of famine are so thin and assume it's good genetics)

If only there was some sort of action they could perform, some kind of "physical exercise" if you will, that could be used to maintain a higher metabolism and thus losing weight. It's a shame that humans are incapable of that and are just stuck with the weight that was determined by genetics.

It's an actual condition when your metabolic rate declines during the process of caloric restriction or weight loss to such a degree that further weight loss becomes impossible. It's a thing which usually happens during famines or in advanced stages of anorexia, when a person is already so emancipated that they don't have any reserve fat left in their body to draw energy from so when their body does receive any food it really holds on to those calories just to survive.

Now our HAES friends took this idea and ran with it saying that basically your body goes into starvation mode if you skip a meal once... or just eat the recommended calorie amount per day. It's honestly a slap in the face to anyone who has experienced real famine.
